name: restart
description: /restart exits Claude Code and types `claude -c` into the same terminal once the prompt is back

python.title: Python executable
python.description: What runs restart.py, the helper that outlives Claude and types the relaunch: a name on PATH or a full path, spelled with .exe on Windows.

command.title: Relaunch command
command.description: What is typed into the terminal after /exit. /restart fresh types plain `claude`; /restart <args> types `claude <args>`.

settleMs.title: Settle (ms)
settleMs.description: How long to wait after Claude has exited before typing, so the shell has drawn its prompt (0 to 10000).
